01-living-room.webp.title: Living room
01-living-room.webp.alt: Cream seating and marble-look nesting tables face a timber and marble-look media wall, with muted olive walls and warm ceiling lighting.

02-dining-and-display.webp.title: Dining and display storage
02-dining-and-display.webp.alt: A white dining table with timber chairs sits beside a matching sideboard, open shelves and an illuminated glass display cabinet.

03-kitchen.webp.title: Kitchen and textured backsplash
03-kitchen.webp.alt: Glossy pale upper cabinets and wood-look base units frame a grey geometric backsplash and a clear stone worktop.

04-grey-bedroom.webp.title: Grey bedroom in daylight
04-grey-bedroom.webp.alt: A grey upholstered headboard and blue patterned bedding sit beside a full-height window with layered curtains.

05-teal-bedroom.webp.title: Teal bedroom
05-teal-bedroom.webp.alt: A teal upholstered headboard, matching overhead cabinets and warm timber finishes define the second bedroom.

06-prayer-alcove.webp.title: Prayer alcove detail
06-prayer-alcove.webp.alt: A backlit Ganesha motif and geometric latticework frame a compact prayer alcove with red stepped platforms.
